summary_short.zh: Insomnia 是一款开源、跨平台的 API 客户端，旨在简化 REST、GraphQL、gRPC、WebSocket 和 SSE 等接口的测试与调试。其核心技术亮点在于将多种协议统一在一个界面中，并支持云、本地和 Git 三种存储方式，方便团队协作。开发者无需切换工具即可完成 API 设计、调试和协作，特别适合需要统一工作流的团队。此外，其插件系统和环境变量功能可满足复杂测试场景的定制需求，是 Postman 等商业工具的优质开源替代品。

summaries.en: Insomnia is an open-source, cross-platform API client that simplifies testing and debugging of REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets, and SSE endpoints. Its key technical strength lies in supporting multiple protocols within a single interface, with flexible storage options including cloud, local, and Git-backed synchronization. Developers can use it to design, debug, and collaborate on APIs without switching tools, making it ideal for teams needing a unified workflow. Its plugin ecosystem and environment variables further enhance customization for complex testing scenarios.

summary_short.zh: ASP.NET Core 是一个跨平台的 .NET 框架，用于在 Windows、Mac 或 Linux 上构建现代化的云端 Web 应用。它的核心优势在于模块化架构：你可以按需引入所需组件，从而获得高性能和低开销。这种设计让你能够灵活构建 Web API、使用 SignalR 实现实时通信，或通过 Razor 构建服务端渲染页面。你可以将应用部署到 Docker 容器、Azure 云或任何支持 .NET 的环境中。对于开发者来说，这意味着可以用一套技能栈同时覆盖前后端，并轻松迁移到云端。尝试用它重写一个小型 API 服务，体验其简洁与高效。

summaries.en: ASP.NET Core is a cross-platform .NET framework for building modern cloud-based web applications on Windows, Mac, or Linux. Its key technical strength lies in its modular architecture, allowing you to include only the components you need, resulting in high performance and low overhead. You can use it to build web APIs, real-time apps with SignalR, or server-rendered pages with Razor, and deploy anywhere—from Docker containers to Azure.

summary_short.zh: Kilo 是一个开源的全能工程化编码代理平台，通过命令行界面和IDE插件，将AI驱动的代码生成、编辑与调试整合为无缝工作流。其核心技术“代理式工程”让AI自主执行多步骤任务，跨文件调用工具链，减少开发者上下文切换。用户只需用自然语言描述目标（如“重构登录模块”），Kilo即可自动规划步骤、修改代码并验证结果。适用于快速原型开发、持续集成自动化修复及团队代码审查辅助，将AI从“补全代码”升级为“执行工程任务”，使开发者更专注于架构设计。

summaries.en: Kilo is an open-source coding agent platform that integrates AI-powered code generation, editing, and debugging into a single CLI and IDE extension. Its key innovation is agentic engineering—autonomous, multi-step task execution across files and tools, reducing manual context switching. Developers can use it to automate refactoring, bug fixes, or feature implementation by simply describing the goal, making it ideal for rapid prototyping and CI/CD workflows.

summaries.en: LibreTranslate is a self-hosted machine translation API that lets you run translations entirely offline, protecting data privacy. It uses open-source neural translation models (like Argos Translate) and offers a simple REST API, web interface, and integrations. Technically, it supports model swapping and language detection. You can deploy it via Docker or pip, integrate into apps, or use it as a private alternative to Google Translate.

summaries.en: LTX-2 is an open-source audio-to-video generation model that creates synchronized videos from audio inputs. Its key innovation is a latent diffusion architecture that jointly models audio and video in a shared latent space, enabling precise temporal alignment between sound and motion. You can use the provided Python package for inference or fine-tune with LoRA on custom datasets, making it ideal for applications like dubbing, music visualization, or automated video content creation.

summaries.en: GLM-5 is an open-source LLM designed to transition developers from vibe coding to agentic engineering, solving the challenge of building reliable, long-horizon AI agents. Its key innovation is a hybrid architecture combining a powerful base model with explicit planning and tool-use modules, enabling complex multi-step tasks. You can use it to build coding assistants, automated workflows, or research agentic systems, leveraging its strong reasoning and code generation capabilities.

summaries.en: Hyper-Extract is a CLI tool that uses LLMs to convert unstructured text into structured knowledge graphs, hypergraphs, or spatio-temporal extractions. Its key innovation is leveraging hypergraphs to capture multi-way relationships beyond simple pairwise links, enabling richer semantic representation. You can run it with one command on your data, making it easy to build knowledge bases for RAG, AI agents, or analytical pipelines.
